claims.statement: Each noisy copy has independent Gaussian noise with standard deviation 0.25 per pixel value (values 0-1).
Averaging n independent copies gives RMSE close to 0.25/sqrt(n): 0.125 at 4, 0.0625 at 16, 0.031 at 64.
claims.source: assets/data.json independent vs theory (20 trials, seed 0)
claims.caveat: Holds for independent, zero-mean noise only.

claims.statement: With correlation 0.5 between copies, RMSE stays near 0.18 even at 64 copies; the floor is 0.25*sqrt(0.5) = 0.177.
